title: Harrowgate Freight renewal follow-up
scratchpad:
2yr @ 12% - agreed
route module free 6 mo
me: onboarding after signature
segments: Colm, thanks again. As promised, we have two options for you.
Option one is one year at a seven percent discount.
Option two is a two year term at a twelve percent discount, with the price fixed for both years.
Seven isn't going to get past my CFO. Twelve on two years is more interesting.
What about the route optimization module?
We can include it at no charge for the first six months of the term.
Then it's priced like any add-on, but you'd be locked at today's add-on rate.
Okay. Then let's go with the two year term at twelve percent, with the module included for six months.
Great, that's agreed. I'll write it up exactly that way.
Our CFO signs on Thursdays. When do you need the signature?
We'd like it signed by October thirtieth, so it lands before your current term ends.
That's doable if I get the paper soon.
I'll send the redlines by Monday.
And who sets up the route module for my dispatchers?
I'll schedule the onboarding myself once the contract is signed.

items.text: Harrowgate renews for two years at a 12% discount, route optimization included free for six months
Contract to be signed by October 30
Schedule route optimization onboarding once the contract is signed
